# telnyx_agent_gateway_api (Resource)

An API whose OpenAPI operations an Agent Gateway exposes as tools.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway_id` (String) The gateway id.
- `name` (String) A name for the API, unique on the instance across MCP servers and APIs, regardless of case. Letters, digits, `_`, and `.`. The gateway prefixes the API's tools with it and a hyphen.
- `spec_url` (String) The URL of the API's OpenAPI description.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `auth_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The server's outbound authentication method. Credentials are never returned. A JSON document; use `jsonencode()`. Write-only: never stored in state. Change `auth_wo_version` to send a new value.
- `auth_wo_version` (Number) Change this number to send `auth_wo` again; Terraform cannot detect a change to a value it does not store.
- `base_url` (String) Where the gateway sends the API's requests. `null` takes the description's first `servers` entry.
- `forwarded_headers` (Set of String) Headers copied from the agent's request, by name.
- `open_to_every_key` (Boolean) `true` lets every key on the instance use the server, granted or not.
- `static_headers` (String, Sensitive) Headers sent on every request. A JSON document; use `jsonencode()`.
- `tools` (Set of String) The operations the API exposes as tools, by tool name. `[]` exposes every operation.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Identifies the API.
- `updated_at` (String)
